mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may inhibit CYP3A4, the primary enzyme metabolizing itraconazole, potentially increasing itraconazole plasma concentrations and toxicity risk.
action: Monitor for itraconazole toxicity signs (nausea, hepatotoxicity, QT prolongation); consider spacing doses or selecting alternative antifungal if high-dose turmeric supplementation is concurrent.
